summary: Frontend-only verification of the 4 RightSidebar / Submissions features added this round: CSV export in Submissions Inbox, Shape tab, Divider tab, and the moved Layers dock. All acceptance criteria met, no console/page errors, and existing tabs + mode toggle continue to work.
critical_code_review_comments: SubmissionsModal.downloadCsv uses `URL.revokeObjectURL(url)` immediately after `a.click()`; in some browsers this can cancel the download. It works in Chromium here, but consider deferring revoke with setTimeout to be safe across browsers.
RightSidebar keeps a module-level mutable `_lastColor` object outside React state — works but is anti-pattern and unrelated to this round; noting for cleanup.
seed_data_creation: Created a single POST /api/submissions with _wd_form='CSV_test' for the CSV download flow, then DELETE /api/submissions?form_name=CSV_test to clean up. Inbox left empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Verified via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Key findings:
- insp-tab-layers NOT present (correct). layers-dock is always visible at bottom of right-sidebar and shows 'Layers · N'. Toggle collapses/expands (layer rows hidden when collapsed).
- All 11 tabs render (grid-cols-4, 3 rows): color, gradient, style, shape, bg, blend, divider, anim, theme, cdn, page. All switch cleanly.
- Shape tab: with a selected block, corner-squircle + shadow-medium + Apply injected inline style containing 'corner-shape', 'border-radius', and 'box-shadow' on the selected canvas element (verified via outerHTML). Apply/Clear disabled with no selection.
- Divider tab: all 10 shapes present (wave, waves, curve, curve-asym, tilt, triangle, arrow, book, split, zigzag). Insert added a new canvas element containing <svg> with <path>, block count incremented by 1.
- CSV export: disabled with 0 submissions, enabled after POST. Clicking triggered a real download with filename webdojo-submissions-all-forms.csv (87 bytes with header + 1 row).
- Mode toggle Design/Code/Preview still works. No pageerror events. Backend accessible only via curl/page.request (urllib blocked by Cloudflare 403 — use page.request in future browser tests).
